source_note: 函数与序列的上下极限
english_source_note: Limsup and Liminf of Functions and Sequences
callout_id: 函数与序列的上下极限#7
statement_en: Let $$x_n=\begin{cases}2&n=2k\\1/2&n=2k+1.\end{cases}$$ Then $\limsup_{n\to \infty} x_n=2$ and $\limsup_{n\to \infty} \frac{1}{x_n}=2$, hence $$\limsup_{n\to \infty} x_n\limsup_{n\to \infty} \frac{1}{x_n}=4>1,$$ and also $$\liminf_{n\to \infty} x_n\liminf_{n\to \infty} \frac{1}{x_n}=\frac{1}{4}<1.$$
callout_body: $$x_n=\begin{cases}2&n=2k\\1/2&n=2k+1\end{cases}$$那么$\limsup_{n\to \infty} x_n=2,\limsup_{n\to \infty} \frac{1}{x_n}=2$,从而$$\limsup_{n\to \infty} x_n\limsup_{n\to \infty} \frac{1}{x_n}=4>1$$以及$$\liminf_{n\to \infty} x_n\liminf_{n\to \infty} \frac{1}{x_n}=\frac{1}{4}<1$$
